headlines.title: Angie Nixon projected winner in Florida Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects Angie Nixon will win the Florida Democratic primary for Senate. It is a major upset over former National Security Council aide Alex Vindman.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. Cory Mills loses his Florida primary amid investigations
headlines.description: Mills lost to Republican Ryan Elijah, NBC News projects, while facing House Ethics Committee and Justice Department investigations. Mills has denied wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Republican Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly set to square off for Florida’s governorship
headlines.description: Donalds and Jolly easily won their primaries, NBC News projects, as Donalds enters the general election with a big financial advantage.

headlines.title: Trump-backed Rep. Harriet Hageman wins Republican Senate primary in Wyoming
headlines.description: Hageman, Wyoming’s lone House member, won the GOP nomination to succeed retiring Sen. Cynthia Lummis, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump pauses 50% tariffs on Canada for 3 days
headlines.description: President Donald Trump late Tuesday slammed the brakes on a wave of tariffs that were set to hit Canada at midnight.

headlines.title: U.S.-South Korea joint military drills are cut short after surprise Trump order
headlines.description: The annual U.S.-South Korea drills, known as Ulchi Freedom Shield, will end Aug. 21 rather than Aug. 27 as originally scheduled, both countries said.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere's mother says she 'sadly lost her way'
headlines.description: Hayden Panettiere's mother Lesley Vogel spoke exclusively to NBC News about her daughter and her on-again-off-again boyfriend. NBC News' Rebecca Keegan has details on a new police report released and what else Vogel had to say.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s ex-partner Wladimir Klitschko shares ‘profound shock’ in tribute
headlines.description: “She left this world far too soon,” wrote Klitschko, the Ukrainian boxer and father of their child, Kaya.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
